extension.description: The Matrix code rain, generated by the addon itself: no video files, no downloads and no network. Twenty-two variants take turns, one of them a 3D tunnel the glyphs fly out of.

Der Matrix-Code-Regen, vom Addon selbst erzeugt: ohne Videodateien, ohne Download und ohne Netzwerk. Zweiundzwanzig Varianten wechseln sich ab, eine davon ein 3D-Tunnel, aus dem die Glyphen entgegenfliegen.
extension.news: v3.6.0 - Building textures stops as soon as the screensaver is dismissed - No background service any more: the lock lives in a window property - The settings file is no longer rewritten on every variant change - Help texts for the display power settings - A PNG icon, as the Kodi repository asks for
